text: {"claims":[{"text":"I scaled a Postgres cluster to 900 million rows at Flipkart.","supported_by":[]},{"text":"In addition, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot for merchant settlement reports.","supported_by":[]},{"text":"During my recent internship at Ledgerly Payments, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot, optimized PostgreSQL queries and Flyway migrations, and reduced the slowest report time from nine seconds to 1.2 seconds using indexes.","supported_by":["b3","b4"]},{"text":"Additionally, I handled on-call rotation duties for two months and gained hands-on cloud experience by deploying a library management system on AWS EC2.","supported_by":["b6","b7"]},{"text":"I also developed a URL shortener in Go with Redis caching, which was load-tested to 2,000 requests per second.","supported_by":["b8"]}]}
